prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.YCB: Keep existing four frozen SOURCE FIT-D banks and V250 input-only selector unchanged. For a minimal SYN-only intervention, reuse existing YCB ref9 bytes. No query true GT object, role, target, r or owner enters selector or model.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.candidate_budget: Prefer preserve all eligible FIT candidates; no support-based budget/seed choice made here. Any cap/reducer must be prospectively fixed by Root before arrays.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.exact_alias_key: SHA256 of inert image content SHA+format/member, typed nullable q8/L8/availability8/box/raw_hw fingerprint, active slot, known original FP32 condition32 bytes; do not use row_id alone, pixel/feature coincidence or new GT owner. Same base exclusion covers all original rendered variants/addresses.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.exclusion: For every FIT query, exclude all candidate rows with the same declared synthetic base_index and every exact input-alias of that query, including SELF/BEFORE-anchor duplicate rows. This exclusion is training/statistical leakage control, not a forward feature. In deployment/DEV, do not use teacher base/role/object identity to prune candidates; fixed FIT assets and input-side address only.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.matched_comparison: To isolate representation preservation, recompute mean CONTROL and exemplar TREAT from the identical FIT candidate multiset AFTER identical same-base/alias exclusions. Comparing old self-inclusive mean CONTROL to a newly excluded exemplar TREAT changes two factors and cannot isolate mean loss.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.namespace: SYN original initializer address0..7 pooled across existing types. This is not a material/class/CAD or certified physical-canonical bank.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.representation: Keep each eligible SOURCE FIT-D three-view descriptor as a separate reference candidate instead of collapsing address pool to one mean. No new encoder, RGB crop, q/L/native/condition or teacher label.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.smallest_scalar_compatibility_option: Keep ref9 and downstream head recipe unchanged once Root selects it. For each selected/next address, rank eligible exemplars using the arithmetic mean of all THREE fixed-view cosine values, choose top1 jointly across views with ascending sample_index first tie, then emit that SAME exemplar cosine3. Mean CONTROL emits cosine3 to the normalized raw mean of the identical candidates. No per-view winner/best-view/DEV threshold selection. This deterministic reducer is a proposal, not implemented or admitted.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.unsupported: Empty after exclusion, missing provenance or invalid descriptor produces explicit reference UNKNOWN/support0 with retained original query/model availability; no fallback to own base, generic target oracle, label E or row deletion.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.what_changes: Reference memory/aggregation and training candidate provenance, not another tiny-MLP architecture search. All3 views and original native condition stay fixed.
prospective_minimal_intervention_proposa.what_it_cannot_establish: Conditional point0 source-D references may still contain background/foreign material or weak target association; storing more references does not certify intended instance, physical visibility at q, wholepart or current-real transfer.
